title: Luxuriant Vietnamese Noodle Soup
description: A rich and flavorful noodle soup inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, made with luxuriant ingredients and a hint of garlicky goodness. This comforting dish is perfect for a cold day.

ingredients.name: Luxuriant Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of shiitake and oyster mushrooms

ingredients.name: Garlicky Ginger
ingredients.notes: Use fresh ginger for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Noodles
ingredients.notes: Soak noodles in hot water for 5 minutes before using

ingredients.name: Vegetable Broth
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade broth for best flavor

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.notes: Use full-fat coconut milk for creaminess

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality fish sauce for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium soy sauce for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh lime juice for a bright and tangy flavor

ingredients.name: Chopped Scallions
ingredients.notes: Use fresh scallions for a pop of color and flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the mushrooms are tender.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped scallions and a squeeze of lime juice.
